name: cachier
description: The prompt cache's time left on the prompt footer as a pie with its time, or with a word (reset, no count) where there is no time, after its mode labels; a click on the pie switches keepalive, and a click on the time, the word or the rebuild figure opens a details pane of five sections, Cache, Keepalive, This session, Advice and Settings, which a bare /keepalive answers with too (the cache's warmth, keepalive's state and cost, its tallies, the session's cache misses, its earlier pauses, its long pauses with the refreshes that cover them, the best setup, and each setting); every cost in dollars at the prices on Anthropic's pricing page, with your own rates where the overrides file sets them, or in tokens by kind, switched by /keepalive unit; failures on the status line; each message's time at its top right; and an opt-in keepalive that keeps an idle cache warm (off by default; each refresh costs a cache read).

keepalive_lead_s.title: Keepalive lead (seconds)
keepalive_lead_s.description: Seconds before the cache expires that a keepalive refresh is sent (default 15). An answered refresh slower than half this raises the lead to twice its round trip for the session; keepalive stops only if that would pass half the TTL. Each refresh re-reads the whole cached context, so each one costs a cache read.

keepalive_count.title: Keepalive refresh cap
keepalive_count.description: Caps the break-even and learned counts of an unpinned run; a prompt starts a new run. Unset, a run sends the learned count, else the break-even count: refreshes until they have cost one rewrite of the cache (about 24 on Opus 5.5 at the 5m TTL). A model with no price sends this option's value, or 3 when it is unset. A count pinned with /keepalive on <lead_s> <count> is sent as pinned. Each refresh costs a cache read of the whole context.

keepalive_default.title: Keepalive at session start
keepalive_default.description: Whether keepalive is on or off when a session starts. A click, or /keepalive on <lead_s> [count] or /keepalive off, changes only the session it is made in; /keepalive default on|off sets this.

cost_unit.title: Cost unit
cost_unit.description: The unit costs start in: dollars at the prices on Anthropic's pricing page, with your own rates where the overrides file sets them (a figure with no price is shown in tokens), or tokens by kind (read, written). /keepalive unit dollars|tokens switches it for the session.

overnight.title: Stop keepalive during your daily rest
overnight.description: Your daily rest is learned from your own idle times, at any hour of the day. Inside the window it leaves, a session's keepalive stops once per local day, after 30 min with no prompt in any session, and resumes at your next prompt. On a 1 h cache it stops only where the refreshes it saves cost at least as much as the rewrite that follows. A conversation of at least 60,000 tokens is also compacted then, as /compact does, which your next prompt does not undo: the summary is one request that reads the whole conversation at the input price, and the first prompt after the rest rewrites the smaller conversation instead of the whole one. off turns all of this off.
